newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER SHOWCASE-TICKET PRICES SOAR BEFORE MADRID CLASH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-TICKET PRICES SOAR BEFORE MADRID CLASH.

text.p: Tickets for the derby clash between Real Madrid and Atletico Madrid were priced at 100,000 pesetas ($680) each by touts five hours before Saturday's kickoff, Spanish TVE television reported.
Some 1,400 police were being deployed for the "high security risk" match.
Real Madrid need only to draw the home game in order to clinch the Spanish championsip. Atletico were said to be on a victory bonus of two million pesetas ($13,600) per player.
